'''Ailish''' was a [[Tarlafar]] and the [[Parent|mother]] of the [[Force-sensitive]] infant [[Bayrn]], living with him in a [[mountain]] [[Unidentified city (Caraad)|city]] on the [[Planet|world]] [[Caraad]]. After her son was witnessed using [[the Force]] to throw a pot while they were out shopping, Ailish rushed him [[Ailish's home|home]], but an [[Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish (Caraad)|neighbor]] reported the child as the [[Galactic Empire]] had placed a [[bounty]] on Force-sensitive [[Youngling|children]]. The [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] then arrived at Ailish's home and [[stun]]ned her before kidnapping Bayrn.

==Biography==
===Undercover mama===
[[File:AilishMarket-IC.png|thumb|left|300px|Ailish attempted to hide Bayrn's Force powers from her neighbors.]]
Ailish was a [[Tarlafar]]<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> [[Gender|female]] who was [[Parent|mother]]<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> to the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|infant]] [[Bayrn]].<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|310}}</ref> the pair lived in a [[mountain]] [[Unidentified city (Caraad)|city]]<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> on the [[Planet|world]] [[Caraad]]. Ailish hoped that she and her exceptional child could avoid the harsher realties of [[the galaxy]] there,<ref name="DB">{{Databank|ailish|Ailish}}</ref> but rumors began to spread about how Bayrn might be gifted or cursed. While out shopping<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> on one of the [[city]]'s market streets,<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> Ailish carried<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> her<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> son to a [[Plant|flower]] stall and placed him on a nearby crate with his doll, stroking his head then leaving him to play while she spoke with the [[Unidentified vendor (Caraad)|vendor]]. Bayrn began throwing his doll up in the air and catching it before accidentally throwing it into some pots.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />

With Ailish still distracted, Bayrn climbed down from the crate and crawled over to recover the doll, sending a pot flying through the air with [[the Force]] as<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> he<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> did so. This was witnessed by an [[Unidentified Arcona (Caraad)|Arcona]] and a [[Unidentified human (Caraad)|human]] nearby, who pointed out Bayrn as the culprit when an angry [[Unidentified Aqualish (Caraad)|Aqualish]] questioned who had thrown the pot. As the [[Aqualish]] dismissed the idea that an infant could have lifted the pot, Ailish became aware of the commotion and hurried over to collect a Bayrn, who had begun to wail. Apologizing to the trio discussing the incident, she then carried Bayrn away and returned to their [[Ailish's home|home]]. Having listened to the [[Arcona]] speak more about Bayrn's apparent powers, the Aqualish watched the mother enter her home with interest and later reported the child from his neighboring apartment, as the [[Galactic Empire]] had placed a [[bounty]] on Force-sensitive children.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />

===Babynapper Bane===
Based on the Aqualish's tip, the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] and his [[droid]] [[Todo 360]] sought out Ailish's home one night. The mother was playing with Bayrn and his doll on the apartment's couch,<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> feeding him a [[Foodstuff|snack]] and then tickling him,<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> when she heard Bane's footsteps outside. Seeing his silhouette passing by under the apartment's door, Ailish moved Bayrn from a table to the couch slightly further from the door<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> and frowned<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> as she moved over to the entryway.<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> Worried,<ref name="Identity Crisis AD" /> she glanced back at her child as Bane's silhouette returned beneath the door, prompting Ailish to pick up a shovel for defense.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />

[[File:AilishBane-IC.png|thumb|right|300px|Ailish unsucessfully attempted to defend her son from Cad Bane before being stunned.]]
When the door suddenly opened however, Ailish only had [[time]] to gasp before Bane [[stun]]ned her, causing her to drop the shovel and collapse to the floor. While she lay unconscious, Todo confirmed Bayrn was Force-senstivie with a [[blood]] test and then left with Bane and the infant to deliver Bayrn to the Empire, with Bane paying the Aqualish for the tip. The Empire [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] Bayrn as test subject in a [[Tantiss Base|base]]<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> on [[Mount Tantiss]] on the planet [[Wayland]].<ref name="Tantiss">{{Databank|mount-tantiss|Mount Tantiss}}</ref> Bayrn was later rescued from Tantiss Base by [[Clone Force 99]], which took him and other child test subjects that had been kept there to the planet [[Pabu]] with the aim of locating their parents and reuniting them with the children.<ref name="Cavalry">{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Ailish was a doting mother who would do anything to protect Bayrn,<ref name="DB" /> attempting to hide his Force powers and trying to defend him from Cad Bane when the bounty hunter arrived. She had [[Color|white]] [[Hair|fur]], green [[eye]]s, and pink skin.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />

==Equipment==
Ailish wore a matching [[Clothing|shawl]] and dress with a geometric pattern of purple, brown, blue, and white as well as a brown collar.<ref name="Identity Crisis" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Voicing my own mother (and/or my own child?) is a first! You can hear me as Ailish, baby Bayrn and Nanny Droid in episode 10 of Star Wars: The Bad Batch!|Shelby Young|<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=shelby_young|url=status/1775592051373162525|name=[[Shelby Young]]|date=2024-04-03|quote=Voicing my own mother (and/or my own child?) is a first! You can hear me as Ailish, baby Bayrn and Nanny Droid in episode 10 of Star Wars: The Bad Batch! I love my @TheBadBatch fam so much and am beyond grateful to join in on season three! #TheBadBatch #voiceover #starwars|archivedate==2024-04-04|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/b2UfT}}</ref>}}
Ailish was voiced by [[Shelby Young]], who also voiced Bayrn, in "[[Identity Crisis]],"<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> the tenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[April 3]], [[2024]].<ref name="Watch">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref> Although the character's name was listed in the episode's credits, it was unclear which character the name applied to<ref name="Identity Crisis" /> until Young made a post on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|X]] about the characters later on the day that the episode aired.<ref name="Twitter" />
